verdict.rationale: Daily is a real-time video platform, so simulcast or layered video with per-subscriber layer adaptation is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions simulcast, SVC layers, or bandwidth-based layer selection. The nearby items cover other things: the large-call limit on how many participants' tracks each viewer receives, and mesh-network latency improvements.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, publishers send layered or simulcast video and the service adapts the layer each subscriber receives to their bandwidth
